workflow.title: Review a BuhoCleaner Flash Clean result before removing files
workflow.primaryIntent: Decide which scan categories to keep, investigate or remove instead of treating a total as permission.
workflow.description: BuhoCleaner's guide lets you inspect and deselect scan results before Remove. Review cache rebuild costs, logs, installers and Trash separately; a selected-size total is not a measured free-space gain.
outline: Top: permitted real BuhoCleaner scan/details image once cleared; do not fake it
Read View Details, selection and Finder controls using C3
Separate rebuildable caches/Xcode indexes from logs, installers and Trash; do not inherit vendor safe-to-remove promises
Explain permissions as access boundaries, not safety certification, with C4 and older-guide caveat
For repeat growth, compare investigation needs rather than rerunning a blanket cleanup
Later: disclosed Breathing Room example Space preview with bounded source-level alternative and preview caveats
workflow.interactionPass: Hand off a static/local-only review checklist: identify owner; confirm need/backup; estimate rebuild/download cost; inspect selection; record available space separately. No scanner, deletion, synthetic savings or forced code demo.
workflow.avoid: No full comparison matrix expansion, RAM-speedup recommendations, invented hands-on narrative or unconditional periodic cache-clearing advice. Verify any additional Apple filesystem claims before drafting.

comparison.title: Breathing Room vs BuhoCleaner: investigation or cleanup toolbox?
comparison.primaryIntent: Choose a documented Mac maintenance workflow, not a universal winner.
comparison.leadDecision: BuhoCleaner fits users seeking documented uninstall, duplicate, startup and manual scan-review tools. Breathing Room, which we build, may fit source-visible app/helper and recurring-growth investigation needs if its preview/runtime and hosted-AI caveats are acceptable.
comparison.length: Concise decision page; unknown cells say not verified, not No. No separate alternatives doorway.

advantagesTradeoffs.advantage: Documented uninstall, duplicate discovery, startup tools and menu-bar CPU/temperature/fan/network readings; lifetime purchase route is advertised.
advantagesTradeoffs.tradeoff: Commercial full-feature activation, trial removal limit, permissions/helper requirements and channel-specific promotional prices. No independent safety/performance tests.

advantagesTradeoffs.advantage: Free local source-visible storage and grouped app monitoring, with implemented investigation/history and exact saved daily approvals.
advantagesTradeoffs.tradeoff: Preview rather than certified production substitute; Python prerequisite, signing/notarization limitations, untested release parity and hosted authenticated AI boundary; optional paid AI Care. No uninstall/duplicate superiority claim.
